edge_case_summary: Pre-fabricated bridge sections (25m long, 35t each): hatch length ≥27m is the binding constraint — verifies matcher checks hatch dimensions rather than just lift capacity, filtering out vessels with <22m hatches even if cranes are sufficient.

cargo_inquiries.hold_geometry_required: minimum hatch clear length 27m; section dimensions 25m × 3.5m × 2.8m, weight 35t each, 6 sections
restrictions: Deck cargo stowage not acceptable — all sections below deck required
No vessels with less than 27m clear hatch length

readiness.explanation: M/V Baltic Project opens Gdynia 28-May. Gdynia to Gdansk ~30nm at 14.5kn = ~2h, arrives same day. 3 days before laycan start 01-Jun. Hold 1 clear length 30m > required 27m — fits. Hold 2 clear length 24m < 27m — sections cannot be loaded in Hold 2. 6 sections; only Hold 1 (30m) can accept full-length pieces.
date_issues: HOLD_GEOMETRY_NOTE: Hold 2 clear length 24m < required 27m. All 6 sections must be loaded in Hold 1 (30m) — feasible but unusual stow requiring planning approval.

readiness.explanation: M/V Danzig Multipurpose opens Gdansk 26-May — at load port. 6 days before laycan start 01-Jun. HOLD_GEOMETRY_VIOLATION: Hold 1 clear length 21m < required 27m; Hold 2 clear length 18m < required 27m. Sections 25m long cannot fit in either hold. Complete geometric mismatch despite adequate crane lift.
date_issues: HOLD_GEOMETRY_VIOLATION: maximum hatch clear length 21m < required 27m for 25m sections. Cargo cannot be loaded in any hold. Pre-filter miss.

readiness.explanation: M/V Pomeranian Star opens Szczecin 29-May. Szczecin to Gdansk ~120nm at 14.0kn = ~9h, arrives ~29-May — 3 days before laycan start 01-Jun. Hold 1: 34m > 27m, Hold 2: 28m > 27m — both holds accommodate 25m sections. Crane 2×80t satisfies 50t lift with margin. Lashing certification on file. Ideal geometry fit.
